metadata.title: Semiconductor stocks head for worst day of 2026 - MarketWatch

content.text:
June 5, 11:16am ET
Semiconductor stocks head for worst day of 2026
The stock market's red-hot semiconductor trade encountered a serious setback on Friday.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was at 12,876 in recent trading, down 753 points, or 5.21%, according to Dow Jones Market Data. That left the index on track for its biggest daily drop since Oct. 10, when it fell 6.3% after President Donald Trump's tariff threats against China sparked a broad-based selloff.
The index has fallen by more than 7.4% over the past two days, leaving it on track for the worst two-day stretch since April 4, 2025, when it fell 16.7%.
